# FOM Thesis / Paper Template
This is an _unofficial_ Template and not affiliated with FOM Hochschule für Oekonomie & Management, please refer to internal ressources for official guidelines. The logo is subject to copyright of ([FOM](https://www.fom.de/datenschutz.html))

I have taken all current formatting and citations guidelines (based of version Jan. 2024) into account. As this is a private project for my needs, there might be inaccuracies to your specific faculty or course. If you notice any errors, feel free to reach out or contribute to this project yourself.

Throughout commits, code comments or content there will be a mix of languages, so German skills are recommended. I hope to clean this up in the near future.

**Please note**: This template comes bundled with a custom, non-standard chicago citation style which is required by the university. CSL is maintained in following repository: [fom-chigaco-citation](https://github.com/FinnRiedel/fom-chigaco-citation)
